dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, you sound tired. How's work?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, juː ˈsaʊnd ˈtaɪərd. ˈhaʊz ˈwɜːrk?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Busy. I think it's time I took a vacation.
dialogue.reading: ˈbɪzi. aɪ ˈθɪŋk ɪts ˈtaɪm aɪ ˈtʊk ə veɪˈkeɪʃən.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I agree. It's time you thought about your well-being.
dialogue.reading: aɪ əˈɡriː. ɪts ˈtaɪm juː ˈθɔːt əˈbaʊt jʊr ˌwɛlˈbiːɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Where should I go? I want to get away from the city.
dialogue.reading: ˈwɛr ʃʊd aɪ ˈɡoʊ? aɪ ˈwɑːnt tə ˈɡɛt əˈweɪ frəm ðə ˈsɪti.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: How about a beach in southern Thailand? You could recharge for a few days.
dialogue.reading: ˈhaʊ əˈbaʊt ə ˈbiːtʃ ɪn ˈsʌðərn ˈtaɪlænd? juː kʊd ˌriːˈtʃɑːrdʒ fər ə ˈfjuː ˈdeɪz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That sounds perfect. I also want to try meditation. My colleague says it helps.
dialogue.reading: ðæt ˈsaʊndz ˈpɜːrfɪkt. aɪ ˈɔːlsoʊ ˈwɑːnt tə ˈtraɪ ˌmɛdɪˈteɪʃən. maɪ ˈkɑːliːɡ ˈsɛz ɪt ˈhɛlps.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Some temples in Chiang Mai have meditation classes for beginners.
dialogue.reading: sʌm ˈtɛmpəlz ɪn ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ ˈhæv ˌmɛdɪˈteɪʃən ˈklæsɪz fər bɪˈɡɪnərz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Really? Maybe I'll go there instead.
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? ˈmeɪbi aɪl ˈɡoʊ ðɛr ɪnˈstɛd.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Good idea. Even ten minutes a day helps. Just sit quietly and take a deep breath.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd aɪˈdiːə. ˈiːvən ˈtɛn ˈmɪnɪts ə ˈdeɪ ˈhɛlps. dʒʌst ˈsɪt ˈkwaɪətli ənd ˈteɪk ə ˈdiːp ˈbrɛθ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. It's time to book something before I change my mind.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ɪts ˈtaɪm tə ˈbʊk ˈsʌmθɪŋ bɪˈfɔːr aɪ ˈtʃeɪndʒ maɪ ˈmaɪnd.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes! It's about time you had some fun.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs! ɪts əˈbaʊt ˈtaɪm juː ˈhæd sʌm ˈfʌn.
